children: Coca-Cola HBC AG (LSE:CCH) reported Q3 net sales rose 9.6% year over year to €3.503 billion, with volume growth of 5.4%, and raised its 2026 revenue growth guidance while cutting expected net finance costs. It remains on track to complete its Coca-Cola Beverages Africa acquisition by the end of 2026, with Tanzania approval pending.
: Coca-Cola HBC’s Q3 net sales rose 9.6% year over year to €3.503 billion, with 5.4% volume growth. It raised 2026 revenue growth guidance and cut expected net finance costs.
: Coca-Cola HBC said it has received no notice of changes to its Russia business, run independently since 2022. It said Russia provides no funds for other operations or debt service.
: Coca-Cola HBC (CCH) remains on track to complete its Coca-Cola Beverages Africa acquisition by end-2026. Competition clearance is in five of six jurisdictions; Tanzania approval is pending.
: Coca-Cola HBC said it is fully hedged for 2026 sugar and aluminium costs and has covered over 40% of 2027 needs. Fuel, logistics and utility costs remain a pressure.
